items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I have one tape I made with some of the fellas from the church. But I still got it. It sounds pretty good. A fellow named Kurz, Alan Kurz, played the mellophone.

ctx.x: You're playing in the church sometimes. Oh, I've got plenty more. I've got a band.

I have one tape I made with some of the fellas from the church. But I still got it. It sounds pretty good. A fellow named Kurz, Alan Kurz, played the mellophone. And Orwin Kurz used to play at Club Forest with Jules Baduk. Orwin Kurz. And he and I and his son got it. It sounded like the Salvation Army band. But it was pretty good. But as far as playing in churches, kid, I don't play in churches.
I was going to ask you, speaking of no rehearsals, remember when you played the Queen Anne room at the Montaléon?
